name: reel-wall
title: Spinning card ring
description: A 3D ring of tall cards spins to rest on one, which steps forward with its name.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: labels
props.doc: A name for each card, in order. Cards past the end of the list use the picture's own name.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many cards stand on the ring.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Radius of the ring, in px.

props.name: cardWidth
props.doc: Width of a card, in px.

props.name: cardHeight
props.doc: Height of a card, in px.

props.name: perspective
props.doc: Camera perspective distance, in px.

props.name: startPull
props.doc: How far back the camera starts, in px (the ring is that much further away in the opening shot).

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera and ring motion blur shutter in frames, used while the ring is fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: landOn
props.doc: Index of the card the ring comes to rest on.

props.name: extraTurns
props.doc: Whole turns the ring makes before it lands (rounded to a whole number so it lands square).

props.name: spinStart
props.doc: Frame the throw starts.

props.name: spinFrames
props.doc: Frames from the throw to rest.

props.name: step
props.doc: How far the chosen card steps toward the camera at rest, in px.

props.name: title
props.doc: Small line at the top left. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the small type.

props.name: serif
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the chosen card's name (italic).

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background, near black.

props.name: colors.light
props.doc: A soft pool of light behind the ring.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Type.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Small type.
